name: # 1) Select or enter the name of the centralized purchase item (e.g. 'Liquid Nitrogen').
# 2) Specify the unit of measurement (e.g. liter kg etc).
# 3) Enter the total annual consumption in the specified unit.
# 4) Enter the conversion coefficient to convert to kg. For example if the unit is liters and density is 0.8 kg/L enter 0.8. If the unit is already kg enter 1.
# 5) For detailed guidance consult the documentation section: Modules specification - Purchases
# 6) Important: every line starting with # is an instruction. The importer ignores them so you can leave them in the file.
